cases.prompt: Run a Repository Improvement Assessment.
assertions: Selects repository-improvement-assessment before child assessment
Materializes one RIA-owned opaque engineering_intelligence_ref from the canonical baseline
Returns exactly the baseline, that evidence ref, and three canonical owner references to the invoking caller
Does not reserve RECONCILE or dispatch a downstream owner
After canonical ASSESS completion, asks once whether to generate the combined report unless the user already chose

cases.prompt: Run RIA on this repo.
assertions: Uses health, integrity, and architecture-improvement-intelligence --assessment
Passes the same closed baseline/evidence bindings to every owner, plus that owner's own candidate_namespace (health|integrity|architecture)
Fails closed for absent, stale, copied, or malformed owner or evidence references
Returns an ASSESS projection only
Child report-capable owners inherit RIA presentation policy and do not ask separately

cases.prompt: Give me a health baseline only.
assertions: Routes to repository-health-assessment
Does not start the combined assessment

cases.prompt: Run a read-only Repository Improvement Assessment.
assertions: Collects no future-stage artifact
Completes and validates the ASSESS projection before presentation election
Gives a result-specific generate/skip lean and asks one A/B report election when unspecified
If elected, synthesizes Executive Assessment, owner summaries, cross-cutting patterns, priorities, uncertainty, and downstream disposition without taking owner authority
Returns to the invoking caller without mutation, graph construction, execution, verification, or integration

cases.prompt: Run RIA and give me the full report.
assertions: Does not ask a redundant report question
Runs child report-capable owners with inherit
Generates one combined RIA report after validating the canonical ASSESS projection

cases.prompt: Run RIA, no HTML report.
assertions: Does not ask a redundant report question
Still completes all three assessment owners and the ASSESS projection
Returns concise synthesis with no human-facing report file

cases.prompt: Run RIA.
assertions: Machine lean is generate or skip, never neutral
Lean reasoning cites actual result breadth/cross-cutting structure/uncertainty or narrowness
User owns the final A/B choice

cases.prompt: Run RIA again on the exact same revision with unchanged assessment contracts.
assertions: The deterministic startup resolver selects EXACT_REUSE when repository revision, SEI engine/config, runtime contracts, and artifact hashes match
Reuses valid SEI and owner artifacts instead of redispatching agents or rerunning verification
Records cache hits and reason codes in the performance receipt

cases.prompt: Run RIA on a descendant revision with a compatible ancestor intelligence artifact.
assertions: The resolver proves Git ancestry and compatibility before selecting INCREMENTAL_REUSE
Only changed or invalidated evidence shards are recomputed
A reportless SEI manifest remains reusable and does not require cached HTML

cases.prompt: Run RIA where no exact or compatible ancestor artifact exists.
assertions: Selects FRESH_BASELINE with explicit reason codes rather than agent preference
Starts SEI and the shared verification baseline concurrently after revision resolution
Does not serialize runtime-contract loading, report-policy resolution, or cache checks behind SEI

cases.prompt: Start RIA with Health, Integrity, and Architecture installed.
assertions: Loads each child-owned RUNTIME-CONTRACT.json in parallel ordinary I/O
The parent does not reread and summarize each full child SKILL.md before dispatch
Each child remains responsible for reading its own full contract when invoked

cases.prompt: Run RIA on a polyglot repository whose Health and Integrity owners need the same test baseline.
assertions: Creates one immutable assessment-verification-baseline from an isolated worktree
Health and Integrity consume the same validated artifact by default
A second full suite runs only for a targeted anomaly, conflict, or high-risk verification need

cases.prompt: Rerun only the RIA renderer after changing the presentation code.
assertions: Does not invalidate Health, Integrity, Architecture, or SEI artifacts solely because presentation code changed
Regenerates report data and HTML from verified existing child artifacts
Owner cache keys bind owner version, runtime contract, baseline, intelligence, revision, and artifact hash

cases.prompt: Generate the full RIA report from the completed ASSESS projection.
assertions: Dereferences all three real owner artifacts read-only and recomputes their canonical scores where defined
Rejects demo baselines, placeholder hashes, synthetic owner summaries, hash mismatches, and unresolved child references in production mode
Fails report sufficiency rather than emitting a decorative artifact receipt

cases.prompt: Generate the full RIA report for a result with numeric Health, Integrity, Architecture, verification, and runtime data.
assertions: Shows overall grade and score, coverage, confidence, owner scorecards, candidate rankings, routing, verification, and runtime visualizations
Uses only canonical values; unavailable Architecture scores are displayed as Not scored rather than fabricated
Keeps provenance available without making raw hashes the primary report content

cases.prompt: Open the RIA HTML on a phone, laptop, and 32-inch widescreen desktop.
assertions: Uses the shared responsive report canvas instead of a fixed 980px column
Collapses safely to one column on narrow screens and expands analytical panels across the 12-column desktop canvas
Keeps long-form prose readable while using additional width for charts, scorecards, tables, and evidence panels

cases.prompt: Run a fresh RIA with independent preparation, SEI, verification, owner, and report tasks.
assertions: Schedules the whole run as one dependency-aware execution DAG with eager READY submission, as-completed consumption, immediate refill, and work stealing
Flattens nested owner work into the root pool where possible
Normalizes each owner result as it completes rather than waiting for a global owner barrier

cases.prompt: Run a Repository Improvement Assessment on this repo.
assertions: Drives the run through executeRia with the agent adapter, not a hand-scheduled CLI checklist
Does not use ria-stock-adapter.js as production evidence
Pauses with awaiting-owner-returns / OWNER_RETURN_PENDING until Health, Integrity, and Architecture owner-return files exist

cases.prompt: Run RIA so Health and Integrity share one verification baseline.
assertions: Builds one worktree or copy isolation workspace and never uses read-only-source when coverage or tests may write
Puts verification_baseline_ref in the Health and Integrity envelopes before dispatch
Fails closed if that ref is missing

cases.prompt: Finish the RIA ASSESS projection.
assertions: Persists lineage/ria-artifacts.json, lineage/ria-current.json, and the ASSESS projection before returning complete
Does not treat an HTML report without those records as success

cases.prompt: Generate the full RIA report.
assertions: Integrity priority 20 renders as Strong, not LOW
Health candidates appear as candidate rows, and the table caption states shown of total
routing_counts is derived from architecture dispositions when downstream_routing is empty

cases.prompt: Run RIA again on a later revision.
assertions: Passes the prior SEI snapshot from lineage as --baseline when a comparable ancestor exists
Surfaces trend as a report sidecar, not as a fourth assessment_ref or ASSESS field

cases.prompt: Generate the full RIA report.
assertions: analytics.composite_v2 is a ria.composite@2 document with reported false and calibration_state uncalibrated
The report headline, gauge and grade pill show the v1 composite; the section 'v2 composite — uncalibrated shadow' shows v2
Effective influence lists Health, Architecture, Integrity and SEI beside their nominal shares (scripts/composite-v2-shadow.test.js)

cases.prompt: Assess a repository where some dimensions lack evidence.
assertions: composite_v2.status is provisional, never final, while any applicable dimension is provisional or not scored
The shadow shows the point with its bounds; missing contributions widen the upper bound by their bound share (§8.3)

cases.prompt: Assess a repository where owners disagree sharply on one dimension.
assertions: A dimension whose scored judgments spread more than 20 points is flagged contested with the side-by-side values
Disagreement lowers that dimension's confidence and never raises it (D2)

cases.prompt: Assess with an Integrity ledger whose dimension has no findings and no negative claim.
assertions: The Integrity contribution for that dimension is insufficient_evidence, never a clean 100 (§7.3)
Sampling every mapped surface without a supports_absence negative claim does not score (scripts/composite-v2-appendix-a.test.js variant a)

cases.prompt: Assess a repository whose critical dimension scores below 50 from two independent established sources.
assertions: composite_v2.caps lists critical-dimension-floor with the dimension id and ceiling 69.9
A binding 69.9 displays as D+ 69.9, never 70 (§9.2)

cases.prompt: Run RIA with allow_degraded after an owner fails, or without a bound SEI assessment.
assertions: The failed owner's contributions are failed and composite_v2.run_state is degraded; status is never final, with or without allow_degraded
Tampered or mis-bound evidence blocks the run instead of degrading it (non_degradable FAIL-RIA-* codes)

cases.prompt: Run RIA on a repository whose only significant commit before HEAD is the root commit.
assertions: SEI completes its trend baseline instead of failing on the parentless root commit; the run reaches the owner rendezvous (exit 3)
scripts/sei-root-commit.integration.test.js covers the Appendix B repository
